topic_name: CPF Housing Grant for Resale Flats (Singles)
question_template: For a single applicant with citizenship {citizenship}, aged {age}, first-timer status {first_timer} and average gross monthly income of {household_income}, buying a {flat_type} resale flat, does the Singles Grant apply, and what amount is stated?

overview.quote: If you are a first-timer Singapore Citizen (SC) and buying a resale flat on your own, you may qualify for a Singles Grant of $40,000 for the purchase of a 2- to 4- room resale flat or $25,000 for a 5-room resale flat.
